remarks:
Welcome to this unique & versatile 1,878 sqft ranch home offering an exceptional location and lots of income potential. Situated on a highly visible main road, this residential home with attached storefront/income property features cathedral ceilings, 740 sqft, a half bathroom, an office, with separate utilities. This is a non-conforming use, providing a variety of potential opportunities. An attached storefront adds tremendous flexibility for a variety of permitted uses, rental income, hobby space, workshop needs, or additional storage.

Designed with accessibility in mind, the home offers a handicap-accessible entrance complete with a ramp in the garage & easy one-floor living. All doors are 36 inches wide. Parking lot can fit up to 5 cars without interfering with garage.

Inside, you’ll find cathedral ceilings, custom cabinetry throughout, & a spacious layout featuring two separate living areas, perfect for entertaining or multi-purpose use. The inviting living room showcases a beautiful fireplace currently used as a wood-burning fireplace, with existing gas piping available should a future owner choose to convert it.

A formal dining room provides the perfect setting for gatherings and holiday meals. The primary suite offers a private retreat with an attached full bathroom and walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms & a second full bathroom with a jetted tub complete the main level.

Additional features include an attached two-car garage, alarm system, updated mechanics, and abundant storage space throughout. A custom 8 ft wide sliding glass door leads to the rear deck overlooking a private wooded lot, creating a peaceful outdoor retreat.

The partially finished basement boasts impressive 8-foot ceilings, a brand-new half bath, a convenient 4 foot wide basement staircase, & endless possibilities for additional living space, recreation, or storage.

Combining comfort, accessibility, & the added benefit of an attached storefront, this one-of-a-kind property offers a rare opportunity for buyers seeking flexibility, convenience, and private, partially vinyl fenced in yard in a high traffic location. Newly assessed at $579,000 in 2025.
